description: This Java class defines a custom matcher for testing macro call parameters, specifically for matching parameters by name and value. It is used in testing scenarios to verify macro call parameters in the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MacroCallParameterMatcher
classes.description: A custom matcher class extending TypeSafeMatcher for matching Map.Entry<String, Object> parameters based on name and value matchers.

methods.name: MacroCallParameterMatcher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the macro call parameter matcher with a parameter name and a value matcher.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the parameter being matched.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Checks if the given Map.Entry matches the specified name and value matcher.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Provides a description of the matcher for debugging purposes.

methods.name: describeMismatchSafely
methods.description: Describes the mismatch when the match fails, including which part did not match.

methods.name: hasName
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher for a parameter with a specific name.

methods.name: hasNameAndStringValue
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher for a parameter with a specific name and string value.

methods.name: hasNameAndStringValueStartsWith
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher for a parameter with a specific name and string value starting with the given prefix.

methods.name: hasNameAndStringValueEndsWith
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher for a parameter with a specific name and string value ending with the given suffix.

methods.name: hasNameAndIntegerValue
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher for a parameter with a specific name and integer value.

methods.name: hasNameAndBooleanValue
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher for a parameter with a specific name and boolean value.

methods.name: hasNameAndMapValue
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher for a parameter with a specific name and a map value matcher.
